description: Official implementation of WHALE (Weight-Harness Alternating Learning)
summary: WHALE treats the agent harness—tool definitions, context management, control flow—as a first-class optimization target alongside the weights, alternating small RSFT updates with a Meta-Harness search under a fixed per-cycle budget, and ships clean ablations (rsft_only vs mh_only) so you can actually measure how much of the gain comes from the scaffolding versus the model. That decomposition is the exact problem I hit in PenguPool, where I was hand-tuning routing and tool exposure around a frozen model and had no principled way to know whether the harness or the weights were the bottleneck. The repo is small and reproducible—four launcher scripts per domain, vendored verl, Apache-2.0—so I can drop the alternation loop into a local experiment without rebuilding a training stack.
